dedupe_keys.name: wallonia cross border waste shipments imports and exports by notification

description: This dataset lists notified cross-border shipments of waste into and out of Wallonia, Belgium, under the EU waste shipment rules and the Basel Convention. It is published by the Walloon public service for agriculture, natural resources and environment on the Open Data Wallonie-Bruxelles portal and is harvested by data.europa.eu. Each of about 1,445 records is one notification file, giving whether it is an import or export, the notifier's name, town and country, the treatment installation's name, town and country, the planned transport period, the European waste codes and labels, the recovery or disposal operation code, the planned and transferred weight, the planned and completed number of shipments, the transport mode and the approval date. Coverage is Wallonia with partner countries across Europe. Data are free under a Creative Commons Attribution licence and can be exported as CSV, JSON, Excel or queried through the Opendatasoft API; the portal record was modified in March 2026. Caveats: only notified shipments are included, not waste moving under general information requirements, and weights are declared figures. Simulation uses: flows between waste producers and treatment plants for network and capacity models of waste treatment. Related records: the Eurostat transboundary waste shipments table (data-eurostat-env-wasship-transboundary-waste-shipments) gives national totals, and the Environment Agency international waste shipments (data-ea-international-waste-shipments-england) gives the English equivalent.
